tellings.difference: Says there was one hole, not two (calling the movie wrong), with the metal bent outward as if shot from below.
tellings.link_reason: The same S4 'top hat' craft that Lazar describes as shot by a projectile.

as_told.title: Disc at S4 with a bullet hole shot from below

plain: At S-4, which he describes as a secret site in Nevada, around 1988 and 1989, one craft he calls the top hat had a hole in its rim that looked like it had been shot by a projectile, with the metal clearly bent outward as if hit from below; he also speaks of another he calls the Jell-O mold. Bob Lazar, who says he worked there and saw them, adds that a movie about him got it wrong by showing two holes instead of one. If true, it would mean someone once shot one of these craft.
